The present appeal preferred under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, seeks enhancement of the compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, vide its impugned award dated 13.02.2023.
2. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.
Reply to the applications be filed within six weeks.
Rejoinder thereto, if any, be filed within four weeks thereafter.
3. In the meanwhile, let the TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
This is a digitally signed order.
